title: Conditions of Hire: Money Taken at Confirmation and Held at Collection
content:
A rate class that requires prepayment takes its prepayment share of the whole rental total at the moment the supplier confirms; a class that does not takes nothing until the counter. The prepayment covers the rental days, the statutory charges and the protection products bought in advance, and never the deposit hold, which is authorised at collection and released at return. Where the card is declined the rental stays merely booked and is released; a rental is never confirmed against an unpaid prepayment. A prepaid rental is charged in the currency the supplier publishes, and a conversion the renter elects carries the class's markup. The deposit hold is the class's own amount, is never treated as a payment, and is released within the supplier's own banking time after the vehicle is returned undamaged. Where the renter later cancels, the prepayment is the money the cancellation charge is withheld from.

**What the prepayment is and is not.**

| | Taken in the prepayment | Not taken in the prepayment |
|---|---|---|
| Rental days | yes | |
| Statutory charges | yes | |
| Protection products bought in advance | yes | |
| The deposit hold | | authorised at collection, released at return |

**Two conditions read as a pair.** On a class of the Car Rental Rate Classes that requires prepayment, the money is taken at the moment the supplier confirms, and confirmation and payment stand or fall together: a declined card leaves the rental merely booked, and it is then released. On a class that does not require prepayment, nothing at all is taken before the counter. The deposit hold is separate from both: it is the class's own amount, authorised at collection whatever the class, never treated as a payment, and released within the supplier's own banking time once the vehicle is back undamaged.

**Currency.** A prepaid rental is charged in the currency the supplier publishes. Where the renter elects to be charged in another currency, the class's conversion markup is added. Should the renter afterwards cancel, the money the cancellation charge is withheld from is that prepayment.
